import networkx as nx
import random
G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(11))
G.add_edges_from([(1,9), (2,9), (6,9), (3,10), (5,7), (2,8), (7,9), (4,6)])
while G.number_of_edges() < 32:
    u = random.randint(0, 10)
    v = random.randint(u+1, 10)
    if not G.has_edge(u, v):
        G.add_edge(u, v)
while G.number_of_edges() > 43:
    u = random.choice(list(G.nodes))
    v = random.choice(list(G.nodes))
    if u < v and G.has_edge(u, v):
        G.remove_edge(u, v)
print(G.edges())
